title: Circ_0003570 Suppresses Hepatocellular Carcinoma via miR-182-5p/STARD13 Axis
author: Zhang, Chen, et al.
materials: Total RNA from cells was extracted with Trizol reagent (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Then, the cDNA was synthesized following the protocol of Evo M-MLV RT Premix for qPCR (Accurate Biotechnology, Hunan, China) and Goldenstar™ RT6 cDNA Synthesis Kit (TsingKe, China). Quantitative real-time PCR was carried out using Master qPCR Mix (TsingKe, China) on a CFX96 Real-Time PCR system (Bio-Rad, CA, USA). The relative gene expression was calculated using the 2−ΔΔCt method. β-actin was served as the internal reference of mRNA/circRNA, and U6 was considered as the internal reference of miRNA. The primers in the study were showed in Table 2.Table 2The primers in the studyForward PrimerReverse Primercommon reverse primerhas-circ_0003570GCACAGCACACGCCAAAAAGAGGGCATTTCCTGTCCAmiR-182-5pCGCTTTGGCAATGGTAGAACTGTCGTATCGACTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTCGCAGTCGATACGACAGTGTGACTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTSTARD13CGAGGAGACAGAAATGGGTCATCCACTGCTTTCGCTGTGAATβ-actinATCGTGCGTGACATTAAGGAGAAGAGGAAGGAAGGCTGGAAGAGTGU6GGAACGATACAGAGAAGATTAGCTGGAACGCTTCACGAATTTGCG

After transfection for 72 h, all proteins were isolated by RIPA (Pierce). Proteases and phosphatases were added to RIPA in advance to prevent protein degradation. Protein samples were loaded for electrophoresis (5% gel for concentration and 10% for separation), and then the proteins were transferred on a 0.45 μm or 0.22 μm pore size PVDF membrane (Merck Millipore). After blocking with 5% defatted milk gently for 1 h, the membrane was incubated at 4 °C overnight with primary antibodies (STARD13; Proteintech) at 1:2000 dilution. The next day, the membrane was washed extensively and incubated with secondary antibodies (at 1:2500 dilution; Zhuangzhi Biology, China) for 1 h at room temperature. Proteins bands were detected by using ECL immunoblotting kit (Millipore, USA) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Maintain HCC and LO2 cell cultures
steps.instruction: Thaw and culture the following cell lines obtained from the Type Culture Collection of the Chinese Academy of Sciences: Huh7, Hep3B, HepG2, MHCC‑97L, SMCC‑7721, and immortalized human hepatic cell LO2. Grow cells in Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle’s Medium (DMEM) high‑glucose (Gibco, USA) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (FBS, Gibco, USA) and penicillin–streptomycin (100 U mL⁻¹ penicillin and 100 µg mL⁻¹ streptomycin). Incubate at 37 °C in a humidified atmosphere containing 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Transfect cells with oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Order small interfering RNA (siRNA), miRNA mimics, miRNA inhibitors and corresponding negative‑control oligos from GenePharma (Shanghai, China). Use the sequences listed in Table 1: si‑has‑circ_0003570 sense (CUUGCCAAGAUGGCACAGCTTGCUGUGCCAUCUUGGCAAGTT), miR‑182‑5p mimics (UUUGGCAAUGGUAGAACUCACACUUGUGAGUUCUACCAUUGCCAAAUU), miR‑182‑5p inhibitor (AGUGUGAGUUCUACCAUUGCCAAA), mimics control (UUGUACUACACAAAAGUACUG), inhibitor control (CAGUACUUUUGUGUAGUACA A), siRNA negative control (UUCUCCGAACGUGUCACGUTTACGUGACACGUUCGGAGAATT). Prepare transfection complexes using Lipo8000 (Biyotime, China) according to the manufacturer’s protocol, add the complexes to cells at the desired confluence, and incubate under the standard culture conditions.

substeps.instruction: Dilute each oligonucleotide to the working concentration in serum‑free medium.
Mix diluted oligo with Lipo8000 reagent at the ratio recommended by the supplier.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for the time specified by Lipo8000 (typically 10–15 min).
Add the transfection mixture dropwise to the cells and return to the incubator.

steps.title: Infect cells with circ_0003570 lentivirus and select
steps.instruction: Obtain circ_0003570 overexpression plasmids and lentiviruses synthesized by Hanheng Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (Shanghai, China) and confirm construct sequences by Sanger sequencing. Infect HepG2 and MHCC‑97L cells with either the circ_0003570 overexpression lentivirus or a negative‑control lentivirus. After infection, add puromycin to the culture medium and maintain selection for 2 weeks to generate stable cell lines. Verify stable overexpression by quantitative real‑time PCR (qRT‑PCR).

substeps.instruction: Seed HepG2 or MHCC‑97L cells to reach ~50 % confluence on the day of infection.
Add lentiviral supernatant to the cells (MOI as recommended by the supplier) and incubate for 8–12 h.
Replace with fresh complete medium and culture for 48 h.
Add puromycin (concentration as previously optimized for each cell line) and continue selection for 14 days, changing medium every 2–3 days.
Harvest cells and extract RNA for qRT‑PCR to confirm circ_0003570 expression.

steps.title: Extract total RNA and synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Lyse cultured cells with Trizol reagent (Invitrogen, Carlsbad, CA) following the manufacturer’s protocol to isolate total RNA. Quantify RNA and assess purity. Synthesize cDNA using either Evo M‑MLV RT Premix for qPCR (Accurate Biotechnology, Hunan, China) or the Goldenstar™ RT6 cDNA Synthesis Kit (TsingKe, China) according to the respective kit instructions.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL Trizol per 10⁶ cells, vortex, and incubate 5 min at room temperature.
Add chloroform, vortex, and centrifuge at 12 000 g for 15 min at 4 °C.
Transfer the aqueous phase, precipitate RNA with isopropanol, wash with 75 % ethanol, and dissolve in RNase‑free water.
Set up reverse‑transcription reactions with the chosen kit, using 1 µg RNA per 20 µL reaction.

steps.title: Perform quantitative real‑time PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare qRT‑PCR reactions using Master qPCR Mix (TsingKe, China) on a CFX96 Real‑Time PCR system (Bio‑Rad, CA, USA). Use the primer sequences listed in Table 2: has‑circ_0003570 forward (GCACAGCACACGCCAAAAAGAGGGCATTTCCTGTCCA) with the common reverse primer, miR‑182‑5p forward (CGCTTTGGCAATGGTAGAACTGTCGTATCGACTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTCGCAGTCGATACGACAGTGTGACTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTATT), STARD13 forward (CGAGGAGACAGAAATGGGTCATCCACTGCTTTCGCTGTGAAT), β‑actin forward (ATCGTGCGTGACATTAAGGAGAAGAGGAAGGAAGGCTGGAAGAGTGU6GGAACGATACAGAGAAGATTAGCTGGAACGCTTCACGAATTTGCG) and their respective reverse primers. Run each reaction in triplicate. Calculate relative expression using the 2⁻ΔΔCt method, employing β‑actin as the internal reference for mRNA/circRNA and U6 as the internal reference for miRNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 20 µL reaction containing 10 µL Master Mix, 0.5 µM each primer, and 2 µL cDNA template.
Program the CFX96 with the following cycling conditions: 95 °C 3 min; 40 cycles of 95 °C 10 s, 60 °C 30 s.
Collect Ct values, compute ΔCt (target – reference), then ΔΔCt (sample – control), and finally 2⁻ΔΔCt for fold change.

steps.title: Harvest proteins and run western blot
steps.instruction: Seventy‑two hours after transfection, lyse cells in RIPA buffer (Pierce) supplemented with protease and phosphatase inhibitor cocktails (added immediately before use). Quantify protein concentration, then load equal amounts onto SDS‑PAGE gels (5 % stacking gel, 10 % resolving gel). Transfer separated proteins onto a PVDF membrane (0.45 µm or 0.22 µm pore size, Merck Millipore). Block the membrane with 5 % defatted milk in TBST for 1 h at room temperature. Incubate overnight at 4 °C with primary antibody against STARD13 (Proteintech) diluted 1:2000. Wash, then incubate with HRP‑conjugated secondary antibody (Zhuangzhi Biology, China) diluted 1:2500 for 1 h at room temperature. Visualize bands using an ECL immunoblotting kit (Millipore, USA) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

substeps.instruction: Add RIPA buffer to cells (e.g., 200 µL per 10⁶ cells), incubate on ice 30 min, and centrifuge at 14 000 g for 15 min at 4 °C.
Determine protein concentration with BCA assay.
Mix protein samples with 4× Laemmli buffer, boil 5 min, and load 20–30 µg per lane.
Run electrophoresis at 120 V until dye front reaches the bottom.
Transfer at 100 V for 1 h in transfer buffer.
Block, incubate with primary and secondary antibodies as described, and develop with ECL.

steps.title: Fix, embed, and section tissues for H&E
steps.instruction: Fix harvested tissue specimens in 10 % formalin for 48 h at room temperature. Dehydrate through graded ethanol, clear in xylene, and embed in paraffin wax. Cut sections 4 mm thick (as described). Dewax sections in xylene, rehydrate through descending ethanol concentrations, and perform standard hematoxylin‑eosin (H&E) staining. Observe stained sections under a light microscope.

substeps.instruction: Place tissues in 10 % formalin for 48 h.
Process tissues through 70 %, 80 %, 95 %, and 100 % ethanol (10 min each).
Clear in two changes of xylene (10 min each).
Embed in paraffin, allow blocks to solidify, and cut 4 mm sections with a microtome.
Mount sections on glass slides, deparaffinize in xylene (2 × 5 min), rehydrate through 100 %, 95 %, 80 %, 70 % ethanol (2 min each), and rinse in distilled water.
Stain with hematoxylin 5 min, rinse, differentiate in acid alcohol, blue in ammonia water, then stain with eosin 2 min.
Dehydrate, clear, mount, and examine under the microscope.

steps.title: Conduct immunohistochemistry for STARD13
steps.instruction: After deparaffinization and rehydration as above, perform antigen retrieval (method not specified). Block endogenous peroxidase activity, then incubate sections with primary antibody against STARD13 (Proteintech) diluted 1:200 overnight at 4 °C. The following day, incubate with appropriate HRP‑conjugated secondary antibody at room temperature for 1 h. Develop color with DAB substrate, counterstain with hematoxylin, dehydrate, clear, and mount. Capture images under a microscope.

substeps.instruction: Incubate sections with primary STARD13 antibody (1:200) in antibody diluent overnight at 4 °C.
Wash slides three times with PBS (5 min each).
Incubate with HRP‑linked secondary antibody (dilution as recommended) for 1 h at room temperature.
Wash, then apply DAB solution until desired brown color develops.
Counterstain with hematoxylin for 30 s, rinse, blue in running water.
Dehydrate through graded ethanol, clear in xylene, mount with coverslip, and image.
